rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation on completed supported returns; i1116 (2025) pp.1-2 Election To Claim ... Without Filing Form1116 explicitly instructs the smaller of total foreign tax and regular tax, despite waiving the Form1116 lines15-23 limitation. That primary text establishes the shared min expression. With positive tax, admitted cases meet the election conditions and both use that min; the reply floors regular tax at zero, redundant for the supported computed nonnegative line16. With zero tax and a completed no-election answer the reply returns zero, as confirmed by .transcription/ftc-zero-tax-source-witness.json. Excluded regimes and absent election answers are not asserted equivalent.
